messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "histamine receptor"
set: ["histamine receptor", "Histamine", "blocking histamine", "blocks histamine", "reduces histamine", "muscarinic receptor", "androgen receptor", "serotonin (5-HT2A) receptor", "5HT3 receptor antagonists", "GLP-1 receptor agonist", "angiotensin receptor blockers", "Aldosterone receptor antagonists", "blocking several receptor types", "angiotensin II receptor antagonists", "dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist", "managing itching caused by histamine release"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
